title: HR & ADMINISTRATION EXECUTIVE / MANAGER
description:
**📢 WE’RE HIRING: HR \& ADMINISTRATION EXECUTIVE / MANAGER** 




**📍 Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu** 




**🏢 Company: Robinbosky / ASM Knits** 




**🏭 Industry: Apparel Manufacturing, E\-commerce \& Retail** 




 We are looking for a proactive HR \& Administration Executive / Manager to take ownership of our day\-to\-day HR activities, with a strong focus on recruitment, employee coordination and business administration.
 



**Salary Range \- 18000 to 28000** 




 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



 1\. Recruitment \& Hiring – Primary Responsibility
 



 • Understand manpower requirements from different departments
 



 • Create and publish job openings on LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed and other hiring platforms
 



 • Source and shortlist suitable candidate
 



 s• Conduct initial screening calls and interviews
 



 • Coordinate interviews with department heads / management
 



 • Follow up with selected candidates and manage joining formalities
 



 • Maintain an active candidate pipeline for frequently required positions
 



 • Coordinate recruitment for office, operations, e\-commerce, warehouse, showroom, administration and managerial roles
 



 • Track open positions, interviews, offers, joining dates and hiring status
 



 • Reduce hiring delays and ensure vacancies are filled on time
 



 2\. Employee Communication \& HR Coordination
 



 • Handle day\-to\-day discussions with employees regarding attendance, leave, responsibilities, work\-related concerns and general HR matters
 



 • Act as the first point of contact between employees and management for routine matters
 



 • Coordinate onboarding and induction of new employees
 



 • Maintain employee records and documentation
 



 • Monitor attendance, leave and basic HR compliance
 



 • Coordinate salary\-related information with accounts/management
 



 • Handle resignations, relieving formalities and exit documentation
 



 • Help maintain discipline, accountability and a professional working environment
 



 3\. Business Administration
 



 • Handle routine administrative discussions and follow\-ups across departments
 



 • Coordinate between management, office staff, operations, warehouse, e\-commerce and other teams
 



 • Follow up on assigned tasks and ensure pending matters are closed
 



 • Handle routine communication with vendors, service providers and external parties when required• Maintain important office records, documents and administrative information
 



 • Coordinate meetings, schedules, appointments and internal communication
 



 • Assist management with daily operational and administrative requirements
 



 • Identify recurring administrative issues and help establish better processes
 



 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 • Strong communication and people\-handling skills
 



 • Good recruitment and candidate\-screening ability
 



 • Ability to confidently speak with employees across different levels
 



 • Strong follow\-up and coordination skills
 



 • Organised and capable of handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously
 



 • Comfortable working directly with management
 



 • Good working knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace
 



 • Basic understanding of HR documentation, attendance, payroll coordination and labour\-related processes
 



 • Ability to take ownership rather than waiting for continuous instructions
 



 Experience in HR, recruitment, administration, apparel/textile manufacturing, e\-commerce, retail or MSME environments will be an advantage.
 



 IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who enjoys talking to people, finding the right candidates, solving day\-to\-day issues and keeping the organisation moving smoothly.This is not a purely documentation\-based HR role.The person should be comfortable spending a significant part of the day on:Hiring → Calling → Interviewing → Coordinating → Following up → Resolving → Closing📩 Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or send their resume with current salary, expected salary, notice period and current location.
